entities.name: Eusebio Bardají y Azara
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Eusebio Bardají y Azara was a Spanish politician and diplomat who briefly served as the Prime Minister of Spain in 1837. He also held other offices such as Minister of State. In addition, he was a senator for Cuenca from 1837 to 1840.
